doctrine: ads8: five spec ads (grok, zai, moonshot, claude, claudecode), ads7 grammar: absurd open, plain model, visual quirk never narrated, mouths closed, centre-square composition, guard verbatim
guard: Natural skin texture with visible pores and slight imperfections, documentary realism, no beauty smoothing, imperfect practical lighting, real micro-expressions, natural motion timing with small human hesitations. No readable on-screen text anywhere in frame, no logos, no brand marks. Keep hands either fully out of frame or large, simple and clearly articulated. NO narration, NO voiceover, NO captions, NO avatar or presenter, no music, natural ambient sound only. One single continuous live-action scene, about 5 seconds, subject centered, raw b-roll for an edit. Composed for a centered square crop: every story object stays inside the middle third of the frame and never approaches the left or right edge.

grok.positioning: xAI's general assistant with real-time search and native tool use, on web and mobile, where news breaks first (verified: x.ai, docs.x.ai, 2026-08-29 pairwise pass)
grok.quirk: a pigeon on the bench freezes mid-head-bob when everything around it freezes, one foot still lifted
grok.narration: Your world just changed. Again. Try keeping up. Grok is the assistant that watches the world in real time, from the place where news breaks first. Ask it while it's still happening.
grok.closer: Grok, real-time answers with the sources still warm. Ask it while it's happening. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.

scenes.a: Start on seated {character}, frontal medium shot. At 0.2s a wall of newspapers erupts from the newsstand, splitting around the face like a tsunami around a rock. Deadpan stillness. Sheets surge beside both shoulders, never across the face, ending as two towering curls. Bench, shelter and newsstand stay anchored; displays stay lit. Empty street. End face frontal, sharp, fully clear. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.b: From the inherited curls, at 0.2s newspapers whip inward and snap upright into an absurd press scrum around seated {character}, pages angled like reporters demanding answers. Keep a wide empty corridor before the face. Every sheet remains visible, suspended beside or behind the shoulders; ground papers stay put. Displays keep flipping. Empty street. End face frontal, sharp, fully clear. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.c: Hold the inherited medium framing on seated {character}. Newspaper scrum stays rigid in its exact positions; every ground paper stays put. Displays continue flipping. One eyebrow rises slightly. Slowly draw a black phone from the coat pocket, keeping it below the chest with its back toward camera. Shelter, bench and newsstand remain fixed. Empty street. End face frontal, sharp, fully clear. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.d: Seated {character} turns the phone screen toward camera below the chin: one luminous answer block above three compact source cards. Keep phone and face sharp together; no push into a close-up. As the newsstand display changes, the cards update immediately. Suspended and ground papers stay exactly put; all displays remain lit. Empty street. End phone visible, face frontal and fully clear. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.

props: The shelter frame, glass walls and bench remain fixed in their original positions throughout.
The lit newsstand remains anchored behind the bench, with its racks and remaining newspaper stock intact.
Newspapers already on the ground remain visible in their original positions throughout.
The shelter advertising panel and newsstand displays remain illuminated throughout; none switches off.
One black phone remains in the coat pocket through a and b, is drawn in c, and is presented in d.
